_comment: LuV helium refrigerator (gtceu:helium_refrigerator, type gtceu:closed_loop_cooling; docs/eras/luv.md, machine 1; package LuV-A3).

server_scripts/grindless/luv/helium_refrigerator.js makes one recipe for every live recipe of source.type that takes source.coolant (GTM's cool_hot_<m>_ingot and the molten-metal ones with the ingot mold), at every server load.

Each recipe: the source's hot ingot (or its molten metal and the mold, not consumed) + makeUp + precool.in + the charge (GTM's notConsumableFluid: needed to start, never drained) -> the source's ingot + precool.out. The helium the source gives back stays in the loop.

Energy: the source's EU/t x duration + (source coolant - makeUp) mB re-liquefied at the live rate of reliquefaction.recipe (its EU per mB of liquid helium) x reliquefaction.precoolFactor, spent at max(source EU/t, minEUt): duration = ceil(energy / EU/t).
reliquefaction.fallbackEuPerMb is used only if the live recipe cannot be read (GTM 7.5.3: 1,920 EU/t x 240 t per 1,000 mB). Figures marked tune in luv.md: makeUp (5 %), precoolFactor.
